intro: Brother Joshua is a human priest of the Church of the Holy Light stationed within the grand Cathedral of Light in Stormwind. Dedicated to guiding the faithful, he trains novice priests in channeling the Holy Light to mend wounds and bolster their allies. His quiet service anchors the day-to-day spiritual instruction carried out in the heart of the kingdom.

p: Within the serene halls of the Cathedral of Light, Brother Joshua stands near the main altar, ready to instruct newly called servants of the faith. As a priest trainer for the Church of the Holy Light, Joshua provides instruction on the foundational disciplines of healing, protective wards, and the spiritual focus required to commune with the Light. For young human priests starting their service to the Alliance, he represents one of their first guides into deeper communion with the divine.
